title: Philips Hue Bridge Pro $118.50 Delivered @ Amazon DE via AU
body:
Deal: Philips Hue Bridge Pro $118.50 Delivered @ Amazon DE via AU

[DevGuy] Why buy this over my existing bridge? Aside from all the marketing speak, are there tangible benefits if I dont need to add more devices? Thanks.
[bargaino] Its a downgrade. The new bridge forces you to create a cloud account.
I'm thinking of ditching my old Hue bridge completely, due to the nagging. Pair to HA or SmartThings.
[KangaDrew] The old bridge requires an account also.
[bargaino] requires for new setups? Mine still works without.
[Schumi5] Have the Pro, have never been promoted for anything to Pair.
You must have a setting for HA or Smarthings to auto detect nearby devices potentially
[cagn] If your existing bridge works for you, I’d keep it. Personally I’m looking forward to the faster sync/update time and trying out the whole “use lightbulbs as motion sensor” thing.
[DevGuy] Mine does work, the only thing I dislike is, when starting the hue app, I sometimes have to wait a few seconds to see the lights - sucks when you're waiting to to turn the lights off late at night.
[cagn] From what I’ve read, that should be better, but also just adding a widget/creating a shortcut if you use HomeKit or Google Home could work as well.
Or set up a button that you can access in the way to/from your bed.
[ryanhunt] The motion detection feature sounds pretty awesome if it works as it states - it can detect movement without any extra sensors. This, and the fact it now supports Wifi was the reason I wanted to upgrade. I bought 2x from Amazon DE back when they first came out and they never arrived (despite being shipping). I had to get a refund in the end, so hopefully those that ordered will have theirs turn up
[c0bnut] Just buy a ZigBee hub from SMLight for $30
[cagn] If that works for you/is best for your situation, sure, but it’s not a one size fits all solution. Personally, I run Home Assistant and do have a Zigbee dongle but my HUD bulbs are through the hub, which is set up in HA. I like tinkering, but I don’t want to be having to tinkering just to have light in my house because something crashed, or an update broke something.
[Jupiter123] has anyone purchased one successfully?
I bought it yesterday, but it was cancelled soon after
[silverham] I tried to buy a shaver heads from Amazon Germany multiple times in July but order gets immediately cancelled. I dont trust Amazon DE anymore. No problems with Amazon US/UK though!
[CalmLemons] Yes same issue but I was ordering LED lights. The system just keep on auto cancelling orders.
Also be aware these might require a power adapter plug.
[cagn] It’s Type-C power now, so easy to sort, no switching power brick required.
[Nom] @cagn: You didn't need the power brick anyway, you can just power the old Bridge directly from your PoE Switch with a splitter like this https://www.amazon.com.au/DSLRKIT-Splitter-Ethernet-IEEE802-…
[cagn] @Nom: I am doing that with my current hub already 👍
[cagn] My order shipped about 5 minutes ago… maybe try again?
[scottb721] I just had 8 Wiz bulbs, a Gledopto box and a few Optiplex cabinet brackets delivered from Amazon DE without any problems.
